data.narrative:
Valthos, a seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Kathleen McMahon and Tess van Stekelenburg, has raised $30M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 firms (2 public, 8 private) in the same sector and stage band, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $30M raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression, implying a $75M valuation. Peer-median analysis references four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $700M, though the peer set exhibits substantial dispersion (range: $125M to $4.0B), reflecting heterogeneity in funding rounds and stage definitions within Defense & Security.

The combined analysis supports a valuation range of $64M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $388M. The wide spread reflects the tension between the stage-progression method—which anchors to recent capital raised—and the peer-median method, which captures market valuations of later-stage and higher-profile entrants. Key uncertainties include the timing and stage classification of peer funding rounds, Valthos's competitive positioning relative to well-capitalized incumbents, and near-term revenue trajectory in a capital-intensive, long-sales-cycle sector.
